name: ACFR Orchard Fruit Dataset: Multi-Fruit Detection and Yield Estimation
description: The ACFR Orchard Fruit Dataset (2016-multifruit) is an open-access multi-sensor benchmark collected by the Australian Centre for Field Robotics (ACFR) at The University of Sydney. Recorded across commercial apple, mango, and almond orchards in Victoria and Queensland, Australia, the dataset features over 1,300 high-resolution color and near-infrared images captured under variable daytime natural illumination and uniform nighttime strobe lighting, complete with comprehensive bounding circle, bounding box, and pixel-level segmentations for fruit detection and automated robotic yield estimation.
